comment: The maker gave no name to any knob, jack or button on this module, so hovering one shows no tooltip at all. The panel labels only four of the jacks: audio, influence, frequency and randomize. Output 1, a fifth trigger output, is declared in the code and given no jack, so it cannot be reached. The four trigger outputs are all written the same value, so they are a mult rather than four separate signals.
